title: Battles of Uruzgan (1892–1893)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battles of Uruzgan (1892–1893)", at revision 1381472435, opens: "The Battles of Uruzgan were fought in 1892-1893 between the autonomous Hazara tribes of Uruzgan and other allied rebel Hazara groups in Uruzgan, against the Emirate of Afghanistan under Emir Abdur Rahman Khan." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872633, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1893 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
